The SSR repair passes source review and the owner’s native-document check. Hosted Docker confirmation is still pending.

- Final en/ar geometry matches viewport width at 385, 390 and 1280px.

**CI-DOCKER-SSR — NEEDS_EVIDENCE for hosted closure; source repair passes.** [docker-http-probes.mjs:43](/var/folders/d1/tk4y3j012j57stv_sy0qpglr0000gn/T/production-hardening-integration-4lfc21qz/scripts/lib/docker-http-probes.mjs:43) checks the observed localized HTML direction, loading status/busy/live attributes, Next static script and inline bootstrap. No new actionable defect found in the five-path delta. Layout changes add no state or listeners. SSR processing remains bounded by the 1MiB response cap and a fixed set of checks; this is an emitted-document contract, not general HTML validation.
